input_fields.name: expected_member_set
input_fields.description: Expected member identities, not merely an expected count.

result_fields.name: membership_result
result_fields.description: Actual/expected member identities, added/removed members, and count comparison.

procedure: Resolve the group and enumerate its current member identities.
Compare actual and expected sets, then compare counts as a separate field.
Return membership_result and comparison_status with added/removed identities.
Do not modify the group or treat count equality as membership equality.
rejection_rules: Reject ambiguous group identity or incomparable member identifiers.
Do not add/remove members to make the check pass.
